metadata.title: SCS AI Hub Starter FAQ Knowledge Base
metadata.description: 50 starter FAQs for testing chatbot knowledge retrieval.
metadata.important_note: This is sample content, not verified official SCS company information. Replace or approve company-specific answers with the SCS team before production.

faqs.question: What services does SCS provide?
faqs.answer: The starter knowledge base lists ISO Certification, Quality Management, Training & Support, and Audit & Compliance as service categories. Verify these against the official SCS service list.

faqs.question: What is ISO certification?
faqs.answer: ISO certification is an independent confirmation that an organization meets the requirements of a specified ISO management-system standard. The applicable standard depends on the organization's needs.

faqs.question: Why do companies seek ISO certification?
faqs.answer: Organizations may pursue ISO certification to improve processes, demonstrate commitment to a management system, and meet customer or tender requirements. Benefits depend on the standard and implementation.

faqs.question: Which ISO standards can SCS help with?
faqs.answer: Please confirm the exact ISO standards offered by SCS with the company team. This sample FAQ does not assume a complete list of supported standards.

faqs.question: How do I start an ISO certification inquiry?
faqs.answer: You can use the Get in Touch form on the SCS website or share your contact details through the optional chatbot contact form.

faqs.question: What information should I prepare before asking about certification?
faqs.answer: It is helpful to know your organization's industry, approximate size, locations, current processes, and the standard you are interested in.

faqs.question: How long does ISO certification take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the standard, organization size, current processes, readiness, and certification-body schedule. SCS should confirm an estimate for your specific case.

faqs.question: How much does ISO certification cost?
faqs.answer: Costs vary by standard, organization size, scope, readiness, and certification arrangements. Contact SCS for a quote based on your requirements.

faqs.question: Is ISO certification mandatory for every company?
faqs.answer: No. Whether certification is required depends on laws, contracts, customer requirements, and the organization's circumstances.

faqs.question: Can a small business apply for ISO certification?
faqs.answer: Small businesses can pursue ISO certification when it fits their needs and they can implement the relevant requirements. The appropriate approach depends on the business.

faqs.question: What is a quality management system?
faqs.answer: A quality management system is a set of policies, processes, responsibilities, and controls an organization uses to manage and improve quality.

faqs.question: What is ISO 9001?
faqs.answer: ISO 9001 is an international standard for quality management systems. Organizations use it to establish and continually improve processes focused on meeting customer and applicable requirements.

faqs.question: What is ISO 14001?
faqs.answer: ISO 14001 is an international standard for environmental management systems. Confirm with SCS whether this standard is within its current service scope.

faqs.question: What is ISO 45001?
faqs.answer: ISO 45001 is an international standard for occupational health and safety management systems. Confirm with SCS whether this standard is within its current service scope.

faqs.question: What is an internal audit?
faqs.answer: An internal audit is a planned review of processes and records to evaluate whether a management system meets defined requirements and is implemented effectively.

faqs.question: Why are audits important?
faqs.answer: Audits can identify gaps, verify that processes are followed, and help an organization prioritize corrective actions and improvement.

faqs.question: What is a certification audit?
faqs.answer: A certification audit is an assessment conducted by a certification body to determine whether a management system meets the applicable standard and certification requirements.

faqs.question: What is a nonconformity?
faqs.answer: A nonconformity is a failure to meet a specified requirement. The organization generally needs to understand its cause and take appropriate corrective action.

faqs.question: What is corrective action?
faqs.answer: Corrective action addresses the cause of a detected problem to help prevent it from happening again.

faqs.question: Can SCS help us prepare for an audit?
faqs.answer: The sample service categories include Audit & Compliance. Contact SCS to confirm the available audit-preparation support and its scope.

faqs.question: Does ISO certification guarantee a product is perfect?
faqs.answer: No. ISO management-system certification does not guarantee that every product or service is defect-free. It relates to the defined management system and audit scope.

faqs.question: How long is an ISO certificate valid?
faqs.answer: Validity and surveillance requirements depend on the certification scheme and certification body. Check the specific certificate and confirm details with the issuing body.

faqs.question: What happens after certification?
faqs.answer: Organizations typically need to continue operating and improving their management system and meet applicable surveillance or renewal requirements set by the certification body.

faqs.question: Can an organization lose its certification?
faqs.answer: Certification can be suspended, withdrawn, or not renewed if applicable requirements are not met. The exact process depends on the certification body's rules.

faqs.question: What is a gap analysis?
faqs.answer: A gap analysis compares current practices with the requirements of a target standard to identify areas that need attention.

faqs.question: What is documentation in an ISO system?
faqs.answer: Documentation may include policies, procedures, process descriptions, records, and other information needed to operate and demonstrate the management system.

faqs.question: Do all companies need the same ISO documents?
faqs.answer: No. Required documented information depends on the standard, organization context, risks, processes, and applicable requirements.

faqs.question: Can existing processes be used for ISO implementation?
faqs.answer: Often, existing processes can be adapted where they meet the relevant requirements. A review helps identify what needs to change.

faqs.question: What is risk-based thinking?
faqs.answer: Risk-based thinking means considering uncertainties that could affect intended results and taking proportionate action to address risks and opportunities.

faqs.question: Does ISO certification improve customer confidence?
faqs.answer: It may help demonstrate a structured management approach and support customer confidence, but the effect depends on customer expectations and the organization's performance.

faqs.question: What training does SCS provide?
faqs.answer: The sample service categories include Training & Support. Contact SCS to confirm current courses, formats, schedules, and eligibility.

faqs.question: Can training be arranged for a team?
faqs.answer: Team or customized training availability must be confirmed with SCS. Share your topic, team size, and preferred schedule through the contact form.

faqs.question: Are training sessions online or in person?
faqs.answer: The available delivery formats are not specified in this sample data. Contact SCS to confirm online, in-person, or other options.

faqs.question: Do I receive a training certificate?
faqs.answer: Certificate availability and eligibility depend on the specific training program. Confirm this with SCS before registering.

faqs.question: How do I request a quotation?
faqs.answer: Use the website's Get in Touch form or the chatbot's optional contact form. Include the service you are interested in and your basic requirements.

faqs.question: How can I contact SCS?
faqs.answer: Use the Get in Touch form on the SCS website or select Share Contact Details (Optional) in the chatbot so the team can follow up.

faqs.question: Do I have to provide my phone number to use the chatbot?
faqs.answer: No. You can ask the chatbot questions without sharing contact details. Contact information is optional unless you choose to submit an inquiry form.

faqs.question: Can I ask questions without submitting a lead?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can chat with the assistant without filling out the optional contact form.

faqs.question: What happens when I submit the chatbot contact form?
faqs.answer: The form submits the contact details and selected service to the site's lead-management system. The team can then review the inquiry.

faqs.question: What details are needed to submit the contact form?
faqs.answer: The current sample chatbot form asks for your name, email address, phone number, and the service you are interested in.

faqs.question: Can I choose more than one service in the contact form?
faqs.answer: The current sample chatbot form allows one service selection. You can mention additional interests in your message or contact the SCS team.

faqs.question: How quickly will SCS respond to my inquiry?
faqs.answer: A response-time commitment has not been provided in this sample knowledge base. Contact SCS directly if your inquiry is time-sensitive.

faqs.question: Where is SCS located?
faqs.answer: The company's verified address is not included in this sample knowledge base. Please check the official SCS website or contact the company for its current address.

faqs.question: What are SCS's business hours?
faqs.answer: Verified business hours are not included in this sample knowledge base. Please check the official website or contact SCS for current hours.

faqs.question: Does SCS serve customers outside India?
faqs.answer: The geographic service area has not been verified in this sample data. Contact SCS to confirm whether your location is supported.

faqs.question: How can I prepare for a consultation?
faqs.answer: Prepare a short description of your organization, goals, current challenges, desired standard or service, and any relevant deadlines.

faqs.question: Can I ask for support after a service is completed?
faqs.answer: Post-service support availability depends on the engagement terms and service selected. Refer to your agreement or contact SCS for clarification.

faqs.question: What if the chatbot cannot answer my question?
faqs.answer: You can ask a more specific question or submit your contact details through the optional form so the SCS team can follow up.

faqs.question: Are the answers in this chatbot official company commitments?
faqs.answer: These are starter FAQs for development and testing. Confirm company-specific details with SCS before using this file in production.

faqs.question: How should I report an incorrect answer?
faqs.answer: Please contact the SCS website administrator or project owner and provide the question and incorrect answer so the knowledge base can be updated.
